title: Split restoration scan
statement: For every natural number $k$, Boolean words $w,s$, and natural number $j\le |s|$, running the split-restoration machine for $j$ steps from its scan configuration at position $0$ yields the scan configuration at position $j$. There the state is $(0, |w|<j)$, the input head is at position $\min(j,|w|)+1$, the first work tape stores $s$, each other work tape contains true in cells $j\le z<|s|+1$ and is blank elsewhere, every work-tape head is at $j$, and the output is empty.
